# ============================================================
# 2. PRODUCTIVITY CLASSIFICATION
# ============================================================

classify_productivity <- function(planned, actual, distraction, focus) {
  
  if (is.na(planned) || planned == 0) return("Moderate")
  completion <- actual / planned
  
  if (completion >= 0.80 && distraction <= 1.5 && focus >= 4) {
    return("High")
  } else if (completion < 0.50 || distraction > 3 || focus <= 2) {
    return("Low")
  } else {
    return("Moderate")
  }
}


# ============================================================
# 3. DEFAULT TRANSITION MATRIX
# ============================================================

default_matrix <- function() {
  
  P <- matrix(
    c(
      0.65, 0.30, 0.05,
      0.30, 0.50, 0.20,
      0.15, 0.35, 0.50
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
  
  rownames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  colnames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  
  return(P)
}


# ============================================================
# 4. ESTIMATE TRANSITION MATRIX FROM HISTORY
# ============================================================

estimate_matrix <- function(states) {
  
  P <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
  rownames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  colnames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  
  if (length(states) < 2 || all(is.na(states))) {
    return(default_matrix())
  }
  
  for (i in 1:(length(states) - 1)) {
    from <- match(states[i], rownames(P))
    to   <- match(states[i + 1], colnames(P))
    
    if (!is.na(from) && !is.na(to)) {
      P[from, to] <- P[from, to] + 1
    }
  }
  
  for (i in 1:3) {
    row_total <- sum(P[i, ])
    
    if (row_total > 0) {
      P[i, ] <- P[i, ] / row_total
    } else {
      P[i, ] <- default_matrix()[i, ]
    }
  }
  
  return(P)
}


# ============================================================
# 5. STATIONARY DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

stationary_distribution <- function(P) {
  
  pi_vec <- c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3)
  
  for (i in 1:10000) {
    new_pi <- as.numeric(pi_vec %*% P)
    
    if (max(abs(new_pi - pi_vec)) < 0.0000001) {
      return(new_pi)
    }
    
    pi_vec <- new_pi
  }
  
  return(pi_vec)
}

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  data_store <- reactiveVal(study_data)
  
  observe({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      updateSelectInput(session, "delete_date", choices = character(0))
    } else {
      d <- d[order(d$Date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
      choices <- setNames(as.character(d$Date), format(d$Date, "%d %b %Y (%a)"))
      updateSelectInput(session, "delete_date", choices = choices)
    }
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$exam, {
    updateSelectInput(session, "topic", choices = topics_by_exam[[input$exam]])
  })
  
  current_state <- reactive({
    classify_productivity(input$planned, input$actual, input$distraction, input$focus)
  })
  
  output$live_state <- renderUI({
    state <- current_state()
    if (state == "High") {
      div(class = "success-box", h2("\U0001F7E2 High productivity"), p("Excellent study day!"))
    } else if (state == "Moderate") {
      div(class = "warning-box", h2("\U0001F7E1 Moderate productivity"), p("You made reasonable progress."))
    } else {
      div(class = "danger-box", h2("\U0001F534 Low productivity"), p("Use today's data to identify what disrupted your routine."))
    }
  })
  
  output$daily_summary <- renderTable({
    completion <- if (input$planned > 0) input$actual / input$planned * 100 else 0
    accuracy <- if (!is.na(input$problems_attempted) && input$problems_attempted > 0) {
      round(input$problems_correct / input$problems_attempted * 100, 1)
    } else { NA }
    
    data.frame(
      Measure = c("Exam", "Topic", "Planned study", "Actual study", "Completion",
                  "Study sessions", "Breaks", "Problems attempted", "Problems correct",
                  "Accuracy", "Mock score", "Distraction", "Sleep", "Focus", "Productivity"),
      Value = c(input$exam, input$topic, paste0(input$planned, " hours"), paste0(input$actual, " hours"),
                paste0(round(completion, 1), "%"), input$sessions, input$breaks,
                input$problems_attempted, input$problems_correct,
                ifelse(is.na(accuracy), "-", paste0(accuracy, "%")),
                ifelse(is.na(input$mock_score), "-", paste0(input$mock_score, "%")),
                paste0(input$distraction, " hours"), paste0(input$sleep, " hours"),
                paste0(input$focus, "/5"), current_state())
    )
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$save, {
    new_row <- data.frame(
      Date               = as.Date(input$date),
      Exam               = input$exam,
      Topic              = input$topic,
      Planned_Hours      = input$planned,
      Study_Hours        = input$actual,
      Sessions           = input$sessions,
      Breaks             = input$breaks,
      Distraction_Hours  = input$distraction,
      Sleep_Hours        = input$sleep,
      Focus              = input$focus,
      Problems_Attempted = input$problems_attempted,
      Problems_Correct   = input$problems_correct,
      Mock_Score         = input$mock_score,
      State              = current_state(),
      stringsAsFactors   = FALSE
    )
    
    old_data <- data_store()
    old_data <- old_data[old_data$Date != new_row$Date, ]
    new_data <- rbind(old_data, new_row)
    new_data <- new_data[order(new_data$Date), ]
    data_store(new_data)
    
    showNotification(paste("Saved:", current_state(), "productivity -", input$exam), type = "message")
  })
  
  output$history <- renderTable({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
    d <- d[order(d$Date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
    accuracy <- ifelse(!is.na(d$Problems_Attempted) & d$Problems_Attempted > 0,
                       paste0(round(d$Problems_Correct / d$Problems_Attempted * 100, 1), "%"), "-")
    
    data.frame(
      Date        = format(as.Date(d$Date), "%d %b %Y"),
      Exam        = d$Exam,
      Topic       = d$Topic,
      Planned     = paste0(d$Planned_Hours, " h"),
      Studied     = paste0(d$Study_Hours, " h"),
      Problems    = paste0(d$Problems_Correct, "/", d$Problems_Attempted),
      Accuracy    = accuracy,
      Mock        = ifelse(is.na(d$Mock_Score), "-", paste0(d$Mock_Score, "%")),
      Distraction = paste0(d$Distraction_Hours, " h"),
      Sleep       = paste0(d$Sleep_Hours, " h"),
      Focus       = paste0(d$Focus, "/5"),
      State       = d$State
    )
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
  
  observeEvent(input$delete_selected, {
    req(input$delete_date)
    d <- data_store()
    target <- as.Date(input$delete_date)
    d <- d[as.Date(d$Date) != target, ]
    data_store(d)
    showNotification(paste("Deleted record for", format(target, "%d %b %Y")), type = "warning")
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$clear_all, {
    if (isTRUE(input$confirm_clear_all)) {
      data_store(study_data)
      updateCheckboxInput(session, "confirm_clear_all", value = FALSE)
      showNotification("All history cleared.", type = "warning")
    } else {
      showNotification("Check the confirmation box first if you really want to erase everything.", type = "error")
    }
  })
  
  P <- reactive({ estimate_matrix(data_store()$State) })
  
  output$matrix <- renderTable({ round(P(), 3) }, rownames = TRUE)

  topic_insights_data <- reactive({
    d <- data_store()
    exam_sel <- input$topic_insight_exam
    
    if (exam_sel == "All logged exams") {
      if (nrow(d) == 0) return(data.frame())
      agg <- aggregate(cbind(Study_Hours, Problems_Attempted, Problems_Correct) ~ Exam + Topic, data = d, FUN = sum, na.rm = TRUE)
      last_date <- aggregate(Date ~ Exam + Topic, data = d, FUN = max)
      merged <- merge(agg, last_date, by = c("Exam", "Topic"))
    } else {
      all_topics <- topics_by_exam[[exam_sel]]
      d_exam <- d[d$Exam == exam_sel, ]
      
      if (nrow(d_exam) == 0) {
        merged <- data.frame(Topic = all_topics, Study_Hours = 0, Problems_Attempted = 0,
                             Problems_Correct = 0, Date = as.Date(NA))
      } else {
        agg <- aggregate(cbind(Study_Hours, Problems_Attempted, Problems_Correct) ~ Topic, data = d_exam, FUN = sum, na.rm = TRUE)
        last_date <- aggregate(Date ~ Topic, data = d_exam, FUN = max)
        merged <- merge(agg, last_date, by = "Topic", all.x = TRUE)
        
        missing_topics <- setdiff(all_topics, merged$Topic)
        if (length(missing_topics) > 0) {
          extra <- data.frame(Topic = missing_topics, Study_Hours = 0, Problems_Attempted = 0,
                              Problems_Correct = 0, Date = as.Date(NA))
          merged <- rbind(merged, extra)
        }
      }
      merged$Exam <- exam_sel
    }
    
    merged$Days_Since <- ifelse(is.na(merged$Date), NA, as.numeric(Sys.Date() - as.Date(merged$Date)))
    merged$Accuracy <- ifelse(merged$Problems_Attempted > 0,
                              round(merged$Problems_Correct / merged$Problems_Attempted * 100, 1), NA)
    
    threshold <- if (is.null(input$review_threshold) || is.na(input$review_threshold)) 7 else input$review_threshold
    merged$Status <- ifelse(is.na(merged$Days_Since), "Not started",
                            ifelse(merged$Days_Since > threshold, "Due for review", "Up to date"))
    
    status_rank <- c("Due for review" = 1, "Not started" = 2, "Up to date" = 3)
    merged <- merged[order(status_rank[merged$Status], -ifelse(is.na(merged$Days_Since), -1, merged$Days_Since)), ]
    merged
  })
